balanced.tradeoff: Selected balanced profile for routine work with a quality-first Sol high review gate.

mixed.tradeoff: Experimental explicit opt-in efficiency profile for measured, bounded work; not the normal quality-first driver.

maximum.tradeoff: Explicit quality-first profile with Sol high as the standing root driver.

policy.low_confidence_rule: Research more first. If confidence stays below 95%, escalate the difficult slice or review to high, then xhigh if needed.
policy.reasoning_effort_rule: Use Sol medium as the normal root driver. Escalate hook, renderer, installer, release, CI, or difficult regression slices to high, and use xhigh only when high leaves material risk unresolved.
policy.mixed_profile_rule: Mixed is experimental and requires explicit opt-in. Preserve an existing explicit selection, but do not select it automatically.
policy.review_effort_rule: review_model selects the review model only. Balanced and mixed reviews must explicitly override model_reasoning_effort to high.
policy.lightweight_rule: Use low only for bounded documentation, metadata, or issue-organization work with a clear verification boundary. Use Terra or Luna only when explicitly selected for bounded support work.
policy.escalation_rule: Max is single-task reasoning; Ultra is subagent-backed parallel work. Most tasks do not need either, and neither is a default wizard profile.
